Specify affected unit count of 3,840 units from production lot HG-24B only, pending upload of the completed reconciliation with engineering source records.
Include written stop-sale notices to all affected retailers per contractual requirements, pending confirmation of the current retailer contact list by the sales team.
Specify replacement-unit remedy for consumers consistent with contractual obligations under the retailer agreements.
Obtain completed citation review and circulate final legal analysis supporting the substantial-product-hazard determination before final submission.
